name: Process simulation and digital twins
principle: Rigorous steady-state and dynamic models of units or whole refineries are used for design, planning and what-if studies, and are kept in step with plant data to act as a digital twin. At KIPIC's Al Zour refinery a refinery-wide Aspen HYSYS model supported start-up planning, crude-blend forecasting, sulfur recovery and kerosene yield optimisation and the case study reports USD 950,000 in savings.
